notes.title: Patch 0.5.211.200
notes.content:
We are closely following all videos and feedback from the community about the recent update. Based on these contributions, we have implemented the following fixes and improvements in the latest update:

[b]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the ambient occlusion option in the graphics settings menu, which can now only be configured when dynamic lighting is disabled.
[*]Fixed the resolution issue in the graphics settings, which previously had no effect.
[*]Removed police job objective markers that were confusing players.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed taking hostages or frisking suspects even when they were dead.
[*]Fixed lag caused by gunfights and shootouts.
[*]Fixed a softlock when stealing cars.
[*]Fixed a softlock when opening the house purchase menu after some interactions on the map.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.211.192
notes.content: [p]Eat at the counter, quench your thirst on the sidewalk, sweat at the gym, change your haircut, and tattoo your skin: Sumariti has gained routine, style, and consequences. Nicolau now feels the weight of his choices — literally.[/p][p]Before the release of the GOLD version, we will have two more content updates with a shorter interval between them, which will be the last updates of the alpha version. Hotfixes may be released between updates as needed. Soon, we will share some news about the final version of the game — stay tuned to our social media![/p][p][/p][h3][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added food shops throughout Sumariti. Players can now interact with vendors at specific points on the map and buy various snacks to restore health.[/p][/*][*][p]Soda machines have been scattered across the city. Just approach, insert money, and drink straight on the sidewalk to recover a small amount of health — a quick solution in critical moments.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented the body weight system. Nicolau loses weight by running, cycling, or spending too much time without eating, and gains weight by overindulging in food or drinks. Physical changes are visible and directly affect the character’s appearance. Habits now have real consequences that impact gameplay: overweight Nicolau runs slower and gets tired faster, while a muscular Nicolau performs better in fistfights and deals more damage with punches.[/p][/*][*][p]Strength training is now available at the neighborhood gym. By entering and starting workouts, players will see Nicolau’s physique evolve over time, making him stronger and more robust. A direct visual incentive for those who take discipline seriously.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new fitness clothing to the clothing store. Perfect pieces for working out, running through the streets, or just walking around Sumariti with a sporty style.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented the barbershop system. Players can enter the local barbershop, sit in the chair, and choose from various hairstyles and beard styles, customizing Nicolau’s look for the occasion or mood.[/p][/*][*][p]A tattoo studio is now available on the map. Just step in and choose from different designs to tattoo Nicolau’s body. Mark your skin with symbols, phrases, or drawings — for aesthetics, story, or pure style.[/p][/*][*][p]Began integrating Wwise for vehicle sound management, bringing superior quality and enabling granular sound usage for NPCs (some sounds are still placeholders).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the police car was not correctly saved in the station garage with customized paint and wheels applied in the workshop during police work.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the automatic despawn of the police car when players moved too far from the area during service, ensuring it stays active until the end of the shift.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted police behavior during police work: other officers no longer retaliate against Nicolau while he’s on duty.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted NPC vehicle engine sounds to be granular, allowing for greater sound variation in traffic.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.203.180
notes.content:
[p]The development of the final version of 171 is progressing very well! The entire team is dedicated to delivering a complete and polished experience for all players. We’ll be announcing important news and a release window soon.

We’re heavily investing in expanding the content for the final version. Our goal is to deliver a full world inspired by the rich diversity of São Paulo: small towns, farms, open fields, major cities, mountains, beaches, and more. We’ve also expanded every other aspect of the game: a greater variety of characters – with different styles, behaviors, and accents to reflect greater diversity – more vehicles, and much more interactivity with the game world. We want this experience to feel brand new and far more immersive compared to the Alpha version.

It’s worth highlighting that all the work done in the Alpha version laid the foundation for reaching this new stage. Creating the core systems of the game takes much more time and effort than expanding them. But once these systems are in place, adding and improving features becomes much faster. For example, creating the first vehicle system may take days or even weeks – but adding a second one can take just minutes after modeling. This logic applies to all other game systems.

We’re also working on an engaging story mode that dives deep into the characters and their motivations, allowing players to truly immerse themselves in the world of 171.

We know many of you are eager for news – and that makes us proud. Right now, our main focus is fully on completing the final version. That’s why Alpha updates and promotional content have been released less frequently, just like this update. However, our commitment to the project remains strong! We’re constantly expanding the team, bringing in new talent, and doubling down on our vision.

To check out behind-the-scenes content and news about the Gold version, visit our social media – we regularly post updates, including our most recent Instagram post:
[/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/betagamesgroup/p/DCm-scat9hx"]https://www.instagram.com/betagamesgroup/p/DCm-scat9hx[/url][/p][p]

Thank you all for your support and patience. Stay tuned – we’ll be sharing more news very soon!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37214410/d3f49b9efdc537a2253a2f569d0262222042d675.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.196.178
notes.content:
[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a parking lot to the game map. Now, players can purchase the parking lot and save vehicles there.
[/list]

[b]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]We performed a shallow optimization on the character and vehicle spawn and despawn system across the map, improving memory allocation during gameplay.
[*]Fixed the softlock issue when interacting with the house purchase menu.
[*]Removed the ability to purchase properties on top of vehicles.
[*]Resolved the issue of duplicate vehicle spawns in the garage.
[*]Edited the message about selling vehicles bought from the shop, now highlighting the need to save the vehicle before selling.
[*]Fixed an issue that invalidated weapon selection when switching between on-foot and in-vehicle gameplay.
[*]Fixed an issue where bicycles were being sold for more than their purchase price.
[*]Added the ability to control the intensity of camera animations in the accessibility menu, addressing player requests.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.195.170
notes.content:
[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*]Vertical ladder climbing system: Nicolau can now climb vertical ladders to access new locations.
[*]Cell phone system: Receive messages about game events, take photos and selfies, change wallpaper, ringtone, check your earnings, etc. We are working to add more interactions with the cell phone in future updates.
[*]Property purchase system: Buy houses in the city of Sumariti or rent out your properties to receive daily rent from your tenants. Keep an eye on payments, as some tenants may delay the rent and cause losses by living for free. You can also gain or lose money from buying and selling houses due to property price fluctuations.
[*]The June festival has arrived in Sumariti! The city is decorated for the São João festival!
[*]Collectibles: During this time of year, there are many fires caused by balloons. Put out 10 fires around the city and earn a mysterious reward.
[*]A new mysterious weapon has been added.
[*]Fire extinguishers have been added, which you can find in specific locations around the city.
[*]Implemented support for AMD's FSR 3.0 Super Resolution and Frame Generation for GPUs that support the technology, check if your GPU is supported [url=https://www.amd.com/pt/products/graphics/technologies/fidelityfx/super-resolution.html] HERE [/url] (Experimental - Directx 12 Only).
[*]Updated DLSS to version 3.7 and implemented support for Frame Generation (Experimental - Directx 12 Only).
[*]You can legally sell vehicles acquired by Nicolau at car dealerships for a fair price compared to selling them for scrap.
[*]You can dynamically save more than one vehicle in the safe house garage.
[*]You can save more than one vehicle in the available parking spaces on the map.
[*]The shop HUD system has been reworked to make the screen space cleaner and more organized.
[*]The tip HUD system has been reworked to make the screen space cleaner and more organized.
[/list]

[b]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Motorcycle engine sound volume has been reduced.
[*]Saved game time has been fixed when making new saves.
[*]When changing options in the menu, asterisks will indicate which options have been altered, with yellow asterisks indicating options that require a game restart to apply.
[*]Tree LOD transitions have been optimized to be smoother, minimizing popping effects.
[*]Fixed issue with tree winds causing leaves to float.
[*]Improved car collision speed for destroying the gas station, as it was too sensitive before.
[*]Fixed theft tip and voice-over when Nicolau enters his own vehicle.
[*]Fixed issue with delivery objects falling to the ground when exiting vehicles.
[*]Fixed issue with nearby vehicles being destroyed when the player enters the car dealership. Now, when entering a shop with a vehicle parked nearby, the vehicle is moved aside.
[*]A tip has been added to the HUD for weapon switching to facilitate switching models within the same category.
[*]The frequency and amount of profits from criminal operations have been balanced for a better experience. Now you can receive these profits on your phone or collect them in person.
[*]Delivery job distances and payouts have been balanced for a better experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.181.158
notes.content:
Recently, we published a video demonstrating a test of using motion capture equipment to record cutscenes for the final version of the game in development: https://youtu.be/F70Jf_vJ80U?si=3yfjaR5mJbSFA1ZG

Stay tuned to our social media channels to keep up with more updates about the game's development!

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*]Fuel System in Vehicles: When the gasoline level runs out, the vehicle stops working. You can refuel vehicles at the gas station by pressing and holding the "E" key next to the gas pump.
[*]Fuelless Vehicles Don't Explode: However, they can catch fire with the use of explosives or incendiary weapons.
[*]Vehicle Purchase System at Dealerships on the Map: Each shop is intended for a type of vehicle (popular cars, modern cars, motorcycles, and bicycles). This functionality is in the experimental phase, and we will be collecting feedback over the weeks to improve the functionality until the final completion.
[*]Possibility to Accept or Reject a Ride in the Carpool Job: With an expanded map, this mechanic will become more useful.
[*]Variation in Job Payments Depending on the Time of Day: Our idea is to bring unique aspects to each phase of the day until the final version of the game.
[*]Accumulative Bonus Payment Every 5 Successful Deliveries on Jobs.
[*]Possibility of the Customer Getting Nervous and Aggressive Towards Nicolau on Late Deliveries.
[*]Possibility of Deliveries or Rides for Criminals: If delayed, they may get nervous and initiate a confrontation against Nicolau.
[*]New cheat code to fill up the vehicle's fuel tank: "FILLUP".
[/list]

[b]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced speed sensitivity to destroy objects with vehicles.
[*]Possibility to enter the modification workshop while on a job, allowing to repair a damaged vehicle without the need to cancel the job for it.
[*]Now it's only possible to start a job with the appropriate uniform for the job in question, pay attention to the hints that appear in the upper left corner of the screen.
[*]Buying items in stores is now done by pressing and holding the item button to avoid involuntary purchases.
[*]Rewritten money cheat code, now it's only possible to use the code a few times.
[*]Improved reverse gear speed on motorcycles.
[*]Fixed an issue with motorcycles spinning after a jump.
[*]Enhanced automatic adjustment close to the ground for the motorcycle to have a smoother landing after a jump.
[*]Fixed an issue where Nicolau would get stuck when walking near motorcycles, making it difficult to steal the motorcycle or lift it off the ground.
[*]Fixed an error that caused some vehicles to go through the ground after being spawned.
[*]Optimized VRAM usage for texture loading.
[*]Fixed the possibility of the motorcycle catching fire after some gameplay time.
[*]Fixed the issue of Nicolau screaming infinitely after catching fire.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.173.148
notes.content:
In this update, we have dedicated our efforts to fixing specific issues and implementing improvements aimed at providing a more stable gaming experience while also steering development towards the final version. We will continue to bring new features and enhancements in future updates.

Due to Steam policies, we cannot disclose all the details directly here, but you can stay updated on the latest game development information through our social media channels!

We appreciate your patience and the community's constant feedback, as it helps us continuously enhance the game. If you encounter more issues or have suggestions, please don't hesitate to share them with us. While we may not be able to respond to every interaction, we are always attentive!

[b]IMPROVEMENTS AND FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Now, the death screen automatically restarts the game after a few seconds.
[*] Physics have been added to the soccer balls throughout the map.
[*] When loading a saved game, it starts at Nicolau's house, allowing quicker access to the saved vehicle.
[*] Shortcuts for quick weapon access have been added using the numbered keys 1 to 5.
[*] Sun shadows have been enhanced for a smoother effect.
[*] Motorcycle configuration updated to fall and lose speed more gradually upon collision. This prevents Nicolau from falling with every collision, but in significant crashes, he will fall.
[*] Configured unmanned motorcycles to fall on their own when moving above 5km/h.
[*] Increased character optimization distance (characters were walking in low frames too close to the player).
[*] Added the ability to change the weapon model through the controller when there is more than one weapon in the same category in the inventory.
[*] Improved navigation in the weapon modification shop menu; now, a single click is enough to enter submenus.
[*] Fixed an issue of shooting with weapons inside the vehicle after reloading, as Nicolau could previously shoot at the car dashboard after reloading.
[*] Reduced the required speed to break gates with vehicles.
[*] Enhanced explosive throwing animations.
[*] Improved sound effects for screams when characters are on fire.
[*] Fixed situations where NPCs got stuck:
    [*]-- When getting up from benches and chairs;
    [*]-- On sidewalk curbs;
    [*]-- In parked cars or motorcycles;
    [*]-- On sidewalks and loose blocks;
    [*]-- When bumping into other NPCs.
[*] Now, the job is not canceled when attacking the previous client.
[*] Fixed exaggerated head rotation of NPCs when fleeing.
[*] Fixed the possibility of Nicolau leaning on the motorcycle on uneven terrain.
[*] Fixed a bug where the car briefly became invisible when the player exited it.
[*] Fixed the spawning of residents inside walls in house interiors.
[*] Fixed a bug where spawning a stolen car from a distance resulted in one car on top of another.
[*] Fixed Molotov exploding in Nicolau's hand after holding it for some time.
[*] Fixed adding money with the code PLATA inside vehicles.
[*] Fixed car parts behaving abnormally after the car exploded.
[*] Improved motorcycle suspension, which was excessively soft.
[*] Removed camera collision from some thin objects like trees, trash bins, and poles, as they caused camera teleportation when adjusting the position, disrupting the game's fluidity.
[*] Fixed parts of some vehicles that would deform according to the camera angle.
[*] Removed Christmas decorations found inside garbage bins.
[*] Optimized tree textures, removing redundancy, allowing low VRAM hardware to have a more enhanced gaming experience.
[*] Fixed the issue of configuring the game resolution; now, the game has a smarter search, scanning all supported resolutions in the used scale.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.137.142
notes.content:
After the latest patch, we received feedback regarding some issues with the savegame that needed to be addressed. We gathered as much information as possible from the community in the last few hours, and our team has been working on a solution that is both effective and prompt. In light of this, the following corrections have been made:

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with savegames that were not loading in certain situations. Now, savegames are correctly listed in the saved slots for loading.
[*]Fixed an issue with savegames that were not being saved in certain situations. Now, save slots can be used normally to save progress.
[*]Fixed the name of the newly added vehicle, Mercanto, which displayed the wrong name after the player entered the vehicle.
[/list]

[b]Important Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]After the migration of the graphics engine, we noticed some issues when reloading saves made in the TWO WHEELS update. Unfortunately, the saved vehicle in the garage and conquered areas could not be recovered in this update. However, everything else will continue to function normally. We are willing to assist anyone who wishes to recover the saved vehicle in the garage and conquered areas in their progress. To do so, please contact us via email at: contato@betagamesgroup.com during this month of December and January, providing details about which areas were conquered or which vehicle was in your garage, including possible vehicle customizations. We appreciate your understanding in advance.
[*]Make a backup of the savegame files located in the "Appdata/Local/BGG" directory before proceeding with the update.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.137.141

Thanks to the valuable feedback from the community, we were able to quickly identify some instabilities present in the last update. If you encounter new bugs, please contact us via email at contato@betagamesgroup.com. We appreciate your ongoing collaboration to enhance the gaming experience!

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented a dynamic statistics system in weapon and weapon modification stores, where each item dynamically changes the attributes of accuracy, range, and weapon capacity.
[*] Reduced the camera shake effect when Nicolau shoots.

[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with old save games that did not load correctly (experimental).
[*] Fixed a blockage that prevented the player from taking characters as hostages.
[*] Fixed the collision of bamboo that was causing cars and characters to get stuck.
[*] Fixed the tuning of the Mercanto car, where it was possible to add body kits from another car.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.137.129
notes.content:
This is one of the most important updates to the game. We are aware of the issues many players have faced with performance, and over the past few months, we have conducted a comprehensive refactoring, significantly improving the game's core systems, resulting in substantial gains in terms of performance and stability. We are confident that these changes will provide a smoother and more satisfying experience for a large portion of players. Check below for all the fixes, improvements, optimizations, and new features included in this update!

The reason why this update is larger than usual is due to the graphics engine update to Unreal Engine 5. The upcoming game updates will return to a smaller size.

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*]Weapon customization system: In addition to the visual aspect, each weapon modification now has a practical effect during gameplay. You can now customize your weapons at a specific shop on the map. Customization options include:
[*]Standard or extended magazine, providing a larger ammunition capacity before needing to reload.
[*]Addition of scopes (arcade), allowing for increased zoom during aiming, depending on the chosen scope type.
[*]Addition of lasers, improving shot accuracy.
[*]Addition or modification of stocks and grips, increasing weapon stability during shots and, consequently, accuracy, depending on the chosen stock type.
[*]Addition of suppressor, reducing the sound of the weapon shot for a more stealthy approach. Moreover, you can customize the paint of your weapon according to your taste.
[*]Added enemy cover system: During confrontations, enemies now seek protection behind trees, buildings, and other obstacles when in danger, providing a more dynamic combat experience.
[*]Introduced the possibility of recruiting criminals in conquered areas. Recruits follow and protect Nicolau in his endeavors, engaging in conflicts against authorities, other criminals, and even pedestrians. Recruits accompany Nicolau on foot and also get into vehicles when necessary. They can shoot and participate in confrontations even while inside vehicles. When in the passenger seat of a car, they lean on the door to shoot, while on the back of a motorcycle, they can shoot to protect the player.
[*]When the ammunition of a firearm is depleted, it remains in the inventory, facilitating management between purchasing ammunition and paints in the shops.
[*]Introduced a new radial weapon selector system:
[*]Traditional mode: By scrolling the mouse wheel, you can quickly access available weapon categories.
[*]Detailed mode: By pressing ALT and moving the mouse, you have full access to the weapon inventory, allowing you to switch between categories and models while the game is in slow motion.
[*]Consumables can now be accessed through the weapon wheel, providing greater control and resource management.
[*]Christmas theme added to the game map.
[/list]

[b]OPTIMIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*]Deep optimization in some of the game's core systems, including an improvement in the object spawn system throughout the environment and enhancements in the navigation system and raycasts of characters and vehicles in the world, resulting in a significant performance improvement in gameplay.
[*]All models, textures, and materials of buildings and property objects, such as gates, fences, doors, and windows, have been reworked and optimized. This has led to a reduction in the number of draw calls, ensuring more efficient rendering of the environment and, consequently, a performance increase.
[*]Support for super resolution has been updated through the implementation of DLSS 3.5, providing an enhanced visual experience.
[*]The option to change the game's DirectX has been added, offering two options:
	[*]DirectX 11: More suitable for older GPUs.
	[*]DirectX 12: Recommended for newer GPUs.
[*]The Apex Destruction methodology has been replaced by Chaos Destruction, promoting a more advanced and efficient approach to managing destruction in the game.
[/list]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]The game engine has been updated to version 5.3.2, enabling the use of more recent development tools. Currently, we are not yet utilizing the cutting-edge rendering and physics tools available in Unreal Engine 5.
[*]Models and textures of all firearms have undergone a redesign.
[*]Specific improvements in armed combat.
[*]Enhancements in camera position and FOV.
[*]Camera shake effects have been improved, providing a more immersive experience.
[*]The gun firing particle has also been enhanced with a more realistic lighting effect.
[*]Nicolau's aiming and shooting animations during armed combat have been improved.
[*]Animations for the game's weapons have been added, with specific movements for each detail of the weapon, including the Trigger, Bolt, Cylinder, Tile, Hammer, etc.
[*]Reloads have also received improvements; now, the cartridge is removed and inserted back into the weapon during the reload animation.
[*]The blur effect has been enhanced, providing even better definition to the game.
[*]The subprefecture flowerbed, which had reliefs that could affect vehicle handling, has been leveled to provide a smoother experience.
[*]A firing effect has been added for helicopter shooters, increasing immersion and realism during combat.
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented the game from progressing in the menu when selecting Mandarin language, where the error displayed the text '171NPC' on the initial menu.
[*]Fixed LowLevelFatalError issue on some older GPUs.
[*]Fixed an issue with pedestrians' cars not turning the wheel during a curve.
[*]When popping a wheelie on the motorcycle, the rear wheel now respects the ground location.
[*]Mitigated the possibility of car wheels climbing on nearby objects.
[*]Corrected the direction of the muzzle flash.
[*]Fixed animations and content with negative values when using consumables.
[/list]

[b]Other Information:[/b]
During the implementation of DLSS 3, we were surprised by the anticipated release of FSR 3. However, due to its timing in relation to our development sprint, we opted for implementation in subsequent updates, thus bringing performance improvements to more players.

Some animations used in this update are placeholders. We will be acquiring mocap equipment at the beginning of 2024. This will assist us in creating custom animations for use in the game.

The progress of the weapon wheel construction is constantly evolving. It will receive even more features in the upcoming updates, and your feedback is crucial for good progress. Some functionalities using a joystick are currently limited but should be updated as soon as possible.

Note: The game currently has partial controller support, as described on our Steam page. However, it should be stabilized as development progresses towards the final version of the game.

The DirectX system, when changed in the settings menu, requires manual game restart for the correct application of the system. An automated restart system will be implemented once we introduce a custom launcher, due to engine limitations.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.119.111
notes.content:
[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]

[*] The possibility to throw explosives while the player is driving vehicles.
[*] When popping a wheelie or spinning the motorcycle near the police, the player becomes wanted.
[*] Wind effect on Nicolau's clothes when riding motorcycles at high speeds.
[*] Added a wind sound effect when traveling at high speeds, with lower volume when wearing a helmet or when cutting through the wind.
[*] Added two new categories of melee weapons, one weapon in each category (Machete and Axe). You can find these weapons in specific locations on the map.
[*] It's now possible to throw more than one adhesive bomb and detonate them by pressing "G."

[/list]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Automatic brakes when vehicles are stationary while Nicolau is driving; now vehicles won't move on inclined terrain.
[*] Added handlebar acceleration animation for motorcycles.
[*] When dismounting from a motorcycle, the handlebars now turn in the direction of the player's input.
[*] Reduced sensitivity in motorcycle wheelies.
[*] Increased sensitivity in motorcycle turns during wheelies.
[*] Enhanced the color and intensity of the luminous effect on collectible objects.
[*] Improved textures and visuals of the motorcycles.
[/list]

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the motorcycle would sway while performing a wheelie and spinning at the same time.
[*] Fixed an issue where the helmet appeared without texture in the workshop.
[*] Corrected an issue where Nicolau would get on the motorcycle and have a passenger animation.
[*] Fixed the issue of infinite adhesive bombs.
[*] Fixed an issue with the weapon dealer's trunk that could close after a collision and disrupt the shopping experience in the game.
[*] Adjusted the speed of the stream in the creek, which was previously too fast.
[*] Fixed an issue with the camera tilting when entering a parked vehicle on uneven terrain.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.86.94
notes.content:
[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[list]
[*] The city is in the mood for June and July festivals with flags, balloons and challenges.
[*] A new cheat is added: FLAMEJANTE. When firing the weapon, the surface hit bursts into flames for a brief moment.
[*] A new weapon is added: MOLOTOV
[*] A new limited-time collectible challenge is added: Light 10 campfires scattered around the map using the molotov and unlock a themed set in the clothing store.
[*] A new themed June festival set is added: The themed set is available in the clothing store after completing the challenge.
[*] A new motorcycle helmet is added to the store that can be worn even outside the motorcycle.
[/list]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] The ability to put on a helmet when riding a motorcycle if you stay with the motorcycle for a while. Otherwise, Nicolau will walk without a helmet.
[*] The ability to do cheats inside vehicles is added.
[*] The ability to repair your vehicle before total loss by using the TOBEM cheat is added.
[*] LODs, texture mapping and mathematical calculations of some assets are optimized.
[*] The 3D sound of radios and horns in trucks is corrected, which was not possible to hear when the distant camera was selected.
[*] The problem of overlapping clothes with the vest is corrected, now the heavy vest is under the clothing sets.
[*] The problem of the parked car when being stolen that went down alone in sloping areas is corrected.
[/list]

[h2]CORRECTIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] The problem of the parked truck having burned or floating bodies after a few minutes of start-up is corrected.
[*] The problem of lowered cars falling and sinking into the workshop floor is corrected.
[*] The problem of the Furgone not having a collision after leaving the workshop is corrected.
[*] The problem of explosion particles, smoke and other similar ones being reproduced behind the sky clouds is corrected.
[*] The problem of the consumable medicine becoming negative and without effect when ingested in a consecutive and rapid manner is corrected.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.80.84
Patch 0.5.72.75
notes.content:
[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] A punctual optimization was carried out on some algorithms.
[*] The parkour system has been improved and now allows Nicolau to have greater resistance when falling from low places, making him roll or not when hitting the ground according to his speed.
[*] The combat system has been improved and now allows NPCs to have greater resistance in combat. With this, it is now possible to verify details with greater precision, such as blood splashing on walls and on the ground, in addition to verifying the bruised face with impacts (NPCs in some situations, such as when fleeing, will have lower resistance and may suffer damage more easily).
[/list]

[h2]CORRECTIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem of the rear wheel of the motorcycle entering the ground during turns.
[*] Fixed the problem of changing resolution.
[*] During a fight, the NPC could present random rotation movements.
[*] In some cases, the game identified and automatically opened the VR device.
[*] Occasional crashes when opening the game on some setups could occur.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.5.68.71
notes.content:
[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added support for Xbox controllers (other controllers may be added in future updates)
[*] Added controller vibration system to provide better player immersion
[*] Added automatic joystick usage check to update gameplay and menu icons
[*] Improved motorcycle handling to allow more fluid gameplay
[*] Improved the default speed of the fighting system to allow more fluid gameplay
[*] Improved the character jump system to allow climbing walls up to the limit where the arm reaches and provide more fluid gameplay
[*] Added camera adjustment system using the new visual sensitivity and aim commands isolated between mouse and controller
[*] Added new DLSS 2.0 option modes according to the GPU technology in use.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37214410/1973d0031b46b169f1ea8b9f80f2e3d7add2a916.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37214410/940ea00f24bf1ea440454a5683a0ffde4ae7518a.gif[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added background color to tips and objectives for easier reading
[*] Translated control keys into all languages
[*] Set the game to start with DLSS default active on boards that support technology
[*] If you are on board a police car, radio commands will not appear
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37214410/92fc1e327c7f889d682bddd3f17b26d69f777e18.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37214410/3fba6ebd0d49fad6cf1916264b3699307c632fcf.gif[/img]

[h2]CORRECTIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed problem with Turkish language not loading correctly
[*] Fixed problem with RL maneuver on motorcycle being possible to maintain even at high speed
[*] Added cancellation of entry into vehicles if moving the left analog of the control
[*] Fixed problem of being able to change the map menu with zoom by pressing the left and right directional buttons, which provided visual bugs
[*] Fixed problem of wheel floating on Rage and Mutuka motorcycles while standing still
[*] Fixed problem of incompatible DLSS modes appearing listed in menu which caused instabilities when selected
[/list]
